'''KulaSwap''' is the decentralised exchange of the MELEK ecosystem, deployed on the [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] chain and published at kula.money.

== Function ==
KulaSwap is an automated-market-maker exchange in the constant-product lineage, with pooled liquidity, farming and lending components. KULA is the hub asset: pairs are quoted against it rather than against every other asset directly.

== Pairs and the bridge ==
Principal pairs include KULA/MELEK, and the Hive-Engine assets [[VKBT and CURE|VKBT]] and CURE as VKBT/KULA and CURE/KULA. Those two are bridged from Hive-Engine one-to-one under multisignature custody, which makes them the route between MELEK and outside value.
